title: Simulator shows each column's sell price and profit for the typed cost
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, made after tier A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Margin % 20, tier B % Off 10.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 250 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • At $100.00: Default reads $150.00 and "$50.00 profit" ($100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00, $150.00 − $100.00 = $50.00).
  • Tier A reads $125.00 and "$25.00 profit" ($100.00 ÷ 0.80 = $125.00).
  • Tier B reads $135.00 and "$35.00 profit" (10% off Default's $150.00 = $135.00).

Step 3:

  • The figures change while 250 is typed, with no button to press.
  • Default reads $375.00 and "$125.00 profit" ($250.00 × 1.50 = $375.00, $375.00 − $250.00 = $125.00).
  • Tier A reads $312.50 and "$62.50 profit" ($250.00 ÷ 0.80 = $312.50).
  • Tier B reads $337.50 and "$87.50 profit" ($375.00 × 0.90 = $337.50).
